objective: Reduce false positives subject to retained detection, using development validation only.
selection: Among candidates meeting all recall floors, minimize validation false-positive rate, then false onset rate, then maximize F1; ties prefer earlier candidates. Report target attainment separately. If no candidate meets the floors, retain the old default and report the frontier.
evaluation_scope: Previously inspected validation, used for development selection. No new test access; no claim of independent generalization.
